svg.desc: Qayati and Al-Ailili Historic Houses on Al-Muizz Street LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Antiquities and Tourism STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 695,000 EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This 8-month consultancy project, launched in 2024 under the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, focuses on the preservation and adaptive reuse of the historic Qayati and Al-Ailili houses on Cairo's Al-Muizz Street. It involves comprehensive studies including historical research, architectural analysis, structural assessments, and restoration planning. The project also includes modern infrastructure upgrades and prepares full technical and financial documentation for contractor tendering.
